item.title: Sort of like Arial Rounded MT?
item.description: I found this image via an online photo archive belonging to an artist here in the NL. I’m no typographer but it looks like a slightly wider version of Arial Rounded MT, no? Particular attention towards P, L, C, M, E, and S… very rounded, even ’techno/space-like’. After exhausting the powers of online type queries I am hoping that someone here can help identify this particular face. One thing the artist mentioned was that it was highly possible it was a free font and dated around 2008.
